note: Wording taken only from what the live Dixit app said on 13 Oct 2026. Replace with the Golden Rules from base package v1.1 + v1.1.1. Anything not listed here is refused, never guessed.
full: Two meals a day, only when you're truly hungry, not by the clock.
Each meal in this order: nuts → salad → sprouts → your usual home-cooked meal, until you feel satisfied, not overfull.
Finish the whole meal within 55 minutes.
Nothing in between meals: anything you eat or drink that starts digestion again counts as a meal.
reminder: Remember the order: nuts → salad → sprouts → your home meal, within 55 minutes.
meal_place: This goes in the last step of your meal, after nuts, salad and sprouts.

amounts.nuts: 4 almonds and 4 walnuts, or a handful of soaked peanuts
amounts.salad: a bowl of raw salad, such as cucumber and tomato
amounts.sprouts: sprouted moong, matki or chole, or 2 boiled eggs, in the same quantity as the salad

positions.vegetable: {food} is allowed in the programme. No vegetable is banned; what changes is how you eat.
positions.starchy_vegetable: {food} is allowed in the programme. No vegetable is banned; what changes is how you eat.
positions.staple: {food} is allowed in the programme as part of your home meal. The programme treats rice and chapati as interchangeable.
positions.dairy: {food} is allowed in the programme as part of your home meal.
positions.nut: Nuts are the first step of each meal in the programme.
positions.egg: Eggs are allowed in the programme; 2 boiled eggs can replace the sprouts step.
positions.sweet: The programme asks you to reduce sugar and sweets.

unknown_position: I can't confirm the programme's rule for {food} yet. Please check with your Dixit coach.
between_meals_unknown: I can't confirm yet what the programme allows between meals. Please check with your Dixit coach.
